Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep this between us. I won't pass it to Ruth or post it in any channel, and I won't include it in anything I send to anyone else.

If Ruth needs to know, it's probably best for her to hear it from you or from Mateo, since it came from him. If you'd like, I can help you work out how to raise it with her, or draft a note to yourself to keep track. Just tell me what you need.
